I'm building an auto-rotating slideshow where each slide has a callout box with different text content. When transitioning between slides, I want the callout box to smoothly resize to fit the new content, but I'm getting jarring readjustments as text reflows. Current behavior: Slide 1 callout: 500px wide, 100px tall Transition to Slide 2: Box animates to 450px wide, but text wraps causing height to expand temporarily Then after animation ends and I clear the inline styles, there's a visible jump/readjustment What I've tried: Measuring and animating both width and height simultaneously Locking dimensions during animation with setTimeout Using requestAnimationFrame to ensure proper render order Different easing functions and animation durations see the jump especiall from slide 2 to slide 3 let currentSlide = 0; const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide'); const callouts = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-callout'); const indicators = document.querySelectorAll('.indicator-btn'); function updateSlide() { slides.forEach((slide, i) => { slide.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide); }); const previousCallout = document.querySelector(".hero-callout.active"); let previousWidth = previousCallout?.offsetWidth; let previousHeight = previousCallout?.offsetHeight; callouts.forEach((callout, i) => { if (i === currentSlide) { callout.classList.add("active"); requestAnimationFrame(() => { const newWidth = callout.offsetWidth; const newHeight = callout.offsetHeight; console.log(`Transitioning from ${previousWidth}x${previousHeight} to ${newWidth}x${newHeight}`); if (previousWidth) { callout.style.width = previousWidth + "px"; callout.style.height = previousHeight + "px"; } requestAnimationFrame(() => { callout.style.width = newWidth + "px"; callout.style.height = newHeight + "px"; }); // THIS CAUSES THE JUMP - watch the border resize then snap setTimeout(() => { callout.style.width = ""; callout.style.height = ""; }, 800); }); } else { callout.classList.remove("active"); callout.style.width = ""; callout.style.height = ""; } indicators[i].classList.toggle("active", i === currentSlide); }); } function nextSlide() { currentSlide = (currentSlide + 1) % slides.length; updateSlide(); } function prevSlide() { currentSlide = (currentSlide - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length; updateSlide(); } function goToSlide(index) { currentSlide = index; updateSlide(); } body { font-family: "Merriweather", serif; margin: 0; padding: 20px; background: #f5f5f5; } .hero-slideshow { position: relative; height: 270px; background: #1a4b7d; margin-bottom: 30px; overflow: hidden; } .hero-slide { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background-size: cover; background-position: center; opacity: 0; } .hero-slide.active { opacity: 1; } .hero__grid-container { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; } .hero-callout { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 40px; transform: translateY(-50%); box-sizing: border-box; opacity: 1; width: fit-content; transition: width 800ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), height 800ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); padding: 20px; } .hero-callout:not(.active) { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .hero-callout.active { pointer-events: auto; } .callout__subtitle { font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #ffffff; margin: 0 0 8px 0; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.8s ease-in-out; } .hero-callout.active .callout__subtitle { opacity: 1; } .hero-callout h2 { font-family: "Merriweather", serif; font-size: 32px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff; margin: 0 0 16px 0; line-height: 1.4; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.8s ease-in-out; } .hero-callout.active h2 { opacity: 1; } .hero-callout .btn { background-color: #0052ba; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.8s ease-in-out; display: inline-block; } .hero-callout.active .btn { opacity: 1; } .hero-callout .btn:hover { background-color: #003d7a; } .slideshow-controls { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 20px; margin-top: 20px; } .control-btn { background: #0052ba; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; } .control-btn:hover { background: #003d7a; } .indicators { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .indicator-btn { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); border: none; cursor: pointer; } .indicator-btn.active { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); width: 32px; border-radius: 999px; } Slideshow Resize Issue Example
